definition: Participant sex, harmonized across all AMP programs.
note: Harmonized sex for ALL programs -> observation_concept_id 3046965 'Sex'. `sex` is generated for EVERY participant (AD/PD Title-case Male/Female; CMD/RA-SLE lowercase male/female) and harmonized to MALE 8507 / FEMALE 8532 (per harmonization/variable_crosswalk.tsv). SUPERSEDES msex.json (ROSMAP-only, mixed F/M/Male/Female encoding); msex.json is disabled so the 365 ROSMAP participants who carry BOTH sex and msex don't get two Sex records. Fixes the gap where `sex` was UNMAPPED (no sex.json), so only 365 ROSMAP persons (via msex) had any Sex record -- now all ~2500 do.
